appIdDesc: Get the App ID from Feishu Developer Console > Credentials & Basic Info.
appSecretDesc: The App Secret matching the App ID. Stored only in local plugin data.
oauthPortDesc: Local callback port. Register http://127.0.0.1:{port}/callback as a redirect URL in the Feishu app.
authorizeHint: Opens the Feishu authorization page in the browser.
tasklistDesc: Target Feishu tasklist for synced SiYuan tasks.
categoriesDesc: Checked categories sync to Feishu. Feishu→SiYuan tasks always go to the Feishu Todo category.
needCredentials: Fill in Feishu App ID and App Secret first
needAuthorize: Feishu not authorized, click Authorize Feishu in settings
noTasklistSelected: No target Feishu tasklist found, select one in settings
